sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:97

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:97:1
items.html: The twenty-two letters are included in the Bina within this Hochma, and the ten utterances, etc., and it is found that also Malchut, which is the conclusion, is included in this Hochma, etc., upper Hochma, lower Hochma. Meaning, as above, that the essential revelation of the Hochma is to Malchut, to the Nukva of ZA; and therefore the discernment of Malchut too is intimated in the number of the thirty-two paths. And therefore the Nukva is called lower Hochma, for in her the upper Hochma of thirty-two paths is revealed. And this is what the Zohar says, “and in this Hochma the beginning and the conclusion are found” — the beginning is the Hochma of thirty-two paths, whose first revelation is in the upper Aba; and the conclusion is Malchut, who is called lower Hochma, to whom these Mochin arrive.
